description: This file defines a React functional component 'RevisionContentLocked', which displays a message indicating that the user cannot access certain revision history features due to subscription restrictions. It includes logic for handling subscription plans, UI elements with styling, and a button to navigate to plan options.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript type defining the props for the RevisionContentLocked component, including the subscriptionController of type SubscriptionController.

classes.name: RevisionContentLocked
classes.description: React functional component that renders a message about restricted access to revision history based on user's subscription status.

methods.name: getPlanHistoryDuration
methods.description: Returns a string describing the duration associated with a given subscription plan name ('Core', 'Plus', or default).

methods.name: getPremiumContentCopy
methods.description: Returns a string informing the user about their revision history limit based on subscription plan.
